name: Commitment To Excellence
overview: Scripture calls believers to pursue excellence by wholeheartedly dedicating themselves to their work and conduct, recognizing that opportunities to serve are limited to this life (Ecclesiastes 9:10). Christians are urged to maintain their distinctiveness and influence in the world, like salt preserving flavor and light shining visibly, so that their good deeds glorify God (Matthew 5:13,16). This commitment involves a transformed mind that discerns and follows God's perfect will, reflecting virtues such as truth, purity, and justice in thought and action (Romans 12:2; Philippians 4:8). Moreover, those who are strong in faith are called to selflessly support others, demonstrating excellence through love and humility rather than self-interest (Romans 15:1).
